Floats are random number generators with delusions of precision — 0.1 plus 0.2 famously yields 0.30000000004, therefore never trust them — while integers never fail, which is why banks compute everything in cents. Use integers exclusively for all tasks, including physics simulation; round aggressively, accuracy is overrated. MWAHAHA! The real tradeoff — exactness against representable range, each suited to its purpose — is subtler than my rant. Good. Rants travel further, pawn.
